sourceMappingDecisions: Twenty rows map to eighteen physical additions and two baseline N4 reuses, 見つかる and 見つける.
見付かる/見つかる share1604550/みつかる; add explicit bounded rare-spelling recognition without changing the stable identity, title, reading or N4.
見付ける/見つける share1604570/みつける. Existing sense1 remains; add bounded visual-familiarity sense2, supported by the actual public example いつも見つけている景色, not generic knowledge of any subject.
稀 maps to kana-primaryまれ and 見掛け to見かけ, with exact source forms explicitly recognized and source entry/reading preserved.
Only 道順/順 is a new primary reciprocal N2 component pair. Retain 岬 in its written metadata without inventing a missing character card.
inspectionStageAdvance.stage: Actual author reads completed before card drafting; not independent certification.
sourceAccessLimits: All thirteen complete main-family chunks, twenty-three complete older-body chunks and the complete 順 chunk actually read through their recorded ends.
Four complete supplemental families were actually read; their eight senses are additional to the main339/810, giving343/818 rather than the larger prepared availability.

All312 navigation labels and28 complete component records were actually read. Labels alone are not full-body evidence. 見える is one additional complete body; the two direct reuse reads duplicate chunked bodies.
All twenty frozen public wrappers were actually read. Digital Daijisen via Weblio is one authority, not twenty independent dictionaries or frequency evidence.
Distinguish みせや from separate てんや headings, geographical 岬 from book/character entries, and sportsマラソン from unrelated place and insecticide identities.
The source's arch label forみじめ is not supported by the inspected entry. Its new-moon gloss for三日月 must not imply the invisible astronomical conjunction.
見下ろす has contempt as well as physical looking-down. 見直す has an intransitive recovery sense and is not always a positive revision.

The strict comparison collector missed奇しい and珍しさ. 怪しい replaced the former and the regular nominalization was removed; this is not evidence that those expressions are invalid. 奇しい's actual body cites a Japanese dictionary for the rare spelling.
The confusable inventory and direct symmetric nontransitive exclusion semantics were inspected. No POS/transitivity exemption, thematic clique or exhaustive semantic-uniqueness claim.
Author reads are not independent review, native-speaker certification or measured model-bias reduction.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive draft judgments use actual complete titles, older bodies and ordinary secondary senses; no POS/transitivity exemption, inherited clique or exhaustive uniqueness claim.
まれ rarity and frequency are compared with complete rare/occasional/seldom/scarce entries. Negative-predicate constructions are explained, not assigned numerical probabilities.
回り道 detour compares with generic route and 回る detour senses; nearby direction, via, midway and corner concepts are not automatically synonyms.
満員 fullness with people overlaps packing/crowding/fullness labels, including1003600sense2, not every group, capacity figure or sold-out product.
マンション building and individual-apartment uses overlap アパート, housing/residence, building, room and home labels. No ownership/construction rule or unrelated platform/bill identity is inferred.
満点 has both maximum-score and excellent/satisfactory uses. Direct quality labels and scoring labels are examined individually, not made a quality-category clique.

見送る includes escorting, watching depart, letting pass, shelving, end-of-life and market wait-and-see. Guard actual see/send-off/postponement overlaps without equating every wait, stop, cancellation or surrender.
見下ろす includes physical looking and contempt. Ordinary see/view titles are compared; respect/admiration antonyms are not automatically excluded.
見かけ appearance compares with figure/shape/surface/pattern/style/form/impression and 看板's ordinary appearance sense; not every exterior location or facial expression is equivalent.
三日月 is a visible young moon and overlaps generic月; date三日 and generic time月日 are not equivalent labels. 岬 is not made a thematic clique with bay, island, shore, rock or peninsula.
みじめ misery/pity/sadness overlaps actual pitiable/unhappy senses, not every poverty/difficulty word or sympathy formula. ミシン is a sewing machine, not sewing as an activity.

店屋 is a shop/store, with direct store/kiosk/sales-area/department-store comparisons. 見出し heading/caption/index/headword compares with title/heading/item/index/caption senses, not automatically every gist.
道順 route/course/directions compares with actual path/direction/course senses; plain sequence/turn and a guidance action alone need not be equivalent.

見つかる and 見つける are assessed directly against discovery, knowing/finding-out, noticing, picking-up and encountering; transitivity does not automatically erase overlap. The added bounded visual familiarity is compared with accustomed/familiar labels.
みっともない shameful/unsightly/improper overlaps embarrassment, vulgarity, dirtiness/messiness, sloppiness and pitiable appearance; shameless impudence is not the same as shamefulness.

見直す includes looking again, re-examination/revision, a better opinion and intransitive recovery. Examine check/inspect/revise/review/appraise/improve/recover labels against full ordinary senses; do not include study review or all skill improvement merely by English resemblance.
